run_distributed_train: run distributed training on a Parlai model using SLURM with multiple GPUs and nodes
run_distributed_train_cli: run python -m parlai.scripts.distributed_train -m seq2seq -t convai2 to train a model across nodes
setup_args_distributed: setup argument parser with distributed training args and a configurable TCP port for multi-node communication
review_DistributedTrain_class: review the DistributedTrain class that extends ParlaiScript to orchestrate SLURM-based distributed model training
review_DistributedTrain_run: review the DistributedTrain run method that uses slurm_distributed_context and fsdp_join to train a model
